segments.name: Mineral exploration and evaluation
segments.description: An exploration-stage company conducting mineral exploration and evaluation for heavy mineral sands and rare earth elements around Lake Chilwa in southern Malawi.
segments.evidence: Management has identified that the Group operates in one operating segment, being mineral exploration and evaluation in Malawi.

revenueModel.text: The Group earns no production revenue; its only income is interest on bank deposits and one-off laboratory income from third-party sample preparation and assay services in Malawi.
revenueModel.evidence: Laboratory income comprises one off amounts charged for third-party sample preparation and assay services performed at the Group's Malawian laboratory.
